pit_availability_rule.rule: A classification snapshot becomes usable only on the first joint A-share trading date strictly after its published calendar date, unless an independently frozen publication timestamp proves pre-open availability.
pit_availability_rule.reason: Avoid same-day publication-time ambiguity and prevent retrospective backfill.
pit_availability_rule.carry_forward: Use the latest previously available CAPCO snapshot until the next snapshot becomes available under this rule.
pit_availability_rule.pre_sample_coverage: 2024H1 was published before the V2.8.1/V2.8.2 historical signal sample begins in 2025, so a prior-known sector snapshot exists for the entire 2025-2026 diagnostic window.

forbidden_use: Treating the half-year label as if it were available at the start of that half-year.
Backfilling a later classification result into dates before its publication availability.
Using AlphaDojo current stock_info industry fields as historical classification authority.
Inferring AI-Core eligibility from CAPCO industry membership.
materialization_requirements: Freeze the exact source PDF bytes or equivalent official artifact for each required snapshot.
Record source URL, publication date, SHA256 and parser version.
Parse stock code, stock name and published industry code/name with deterministic validation.
Cross-check duplicate stock codes and coverage against the official PIT research universe for each effective interval.
Do not proceed to sector-conditioned result interpretation until source-byte and mapping receipts pass.
